nodes.description: Mapping address=>uint256 of token balances declared in StandardToken; read and written by transfer, transferFrom, balanceOf and set in the ERC20Token constructor.
Nested mapping address=>address=>uint256 of spending allowances in StandardToken; written by approve and approveAndCall and decremented by transferFrom.
Public total token supply of StandardToken, assigned in the ERC20Token constructor together with the deployer initial balance.
Public human readable token name in ERC20Token, set in the constructor.
Public uint8 decimals value in ERC20Token used for display purposes, set in the constructor.
Public token symbol string in ERC20Token, set in the constructor.
Public version string 'H1.0' of ERC20Token, a vanity identifier with no effect on core logic.
Abstract interface declaration of totalSupply() constant returning the total token amount.
Abstract interface declaration of balanceOf(address _owner) constant returning an owner balance.
Abstract interface declaration of transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) returning success.
Abstract interface declaration of transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) returning success.
Abstract interface declaration of approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) returning success.
Abstract interface declaration of allowance(address _owner, address _spender) constant returning the remaining amount.
Implements transfer: checks balances[msg.sender] >= _value && _value > 0, then performs unchecked subtraction and addition on balances and emits Transfer.
Implements transferFrom: checks balance, allowance and _value > 0, then performs unchecked += and -= on balances and allowed and emits Transfer.
Constant getter returning balances[_owner].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval; no return value check for zero address or race condition.
Constant getter returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Unnamed fallback function that executes throw, rejecting any plain ether transfer to the contract.
Constructor that mints 17777000000000000000000 tokens to msg.sender, sets totalSupply, name 'SEVEN LUCK', decimals 18 and symbol 'LCK'.
Writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender], emits Approval and then performs a low-level call to the untrusted _spender with receiveApproval(...) data, throwing if the call fails.
Caller controlled address used as balance/allowance key, as token allocation recipient in the constructor and as an argument forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.

Low-level _spender.call(bytes4(sha3('receiveApproval(address,uint256,address,bytes)')), msg.sender, _value, this, _extraData) executed after the allowance state update, giving the untrusted callee full control flow (reentrancy) and unchecked return handling.
Unchecked integer arithmetic: balances[msg.sender] -= _value and balances[_to] += _value in a 0.4.x compiler with no SafeMath, so the addition can silently overflow.
Unchecked integer arithmetic: balances[_to] += _value, balances[_from] -= _value and allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value, with potential overflow on the balance addition.
Recipient address parameter of StandardToken.transfer, used as the index of the balances addition.
Amount parameter of StandardToken.transfer, used in the balance check and in the unchecked subtraction/addition.
Source address parameter of StandardToken.transferFrom, index for the balance and allowance checks and for the balance subtraction.
Recipient address parameter of StandardToken.transferFrom, index of the balances addition.
Amount parameter of StandardToken.transferFrom, used in the three guard checks and all arithmetic updates.
Address parameter of StandardToken.balanceOf used as the balances mapping key.
Spender address parameter of StandardToken.approve used as the inner key of the allowed mapping.
Allowance amount parameter of StandardToken.approve written into the allowed mapping.
Owner address parameter of StandardToken.allowance used as the outer key of the allowed mapping.
Spender address parameter of StandardToken.allowance used as the inner key of the allowed mapping.
Untrusted address parameter of approveAndCall that receives the allowance and is the target of the external low-level call.
Amount parameter of approveAndCall written into allowed and forwarded as calldata to the untrusted spender.
Arbitrary bytes parameter of approveAndCall forwarded verbatim into the external call calldata.

edges.reason: StandardToken.transfer implements/overrides the abstract Token.transfer declaration.
StandardToken.transferFrom implements/overrides the abstract Token.transferFrom declaration.
StandardToken.balanceOf implements/overrides the abstract Token.balanceOf declaration.
StandardToken.approve implements/overrides the abstract Token.approve declaration.
StandardToken.allowance implements/overrides the abstract Token.allowance declaration.
transfer contains the unchecked balance subtraction and addition performed without SafeMath.
transferFrom contains the unchecked balance and allowance updates performed without SafeMath.
approveAndCall reaches the low-level external call after mutating the allowance state.
The untrusted callee can re-enter the contract through the receiveApproval callback while approveAndCall is still executing.
_to is used as the index of the balances addition inside transfer.
_value flows into the balance check and into the unchecked subtraction/addition in transfer.
msg.sender indexes balances in transfer, allowing the caller to move only its own funds.
The balances mapping is read and written by the arithmetic operations in transfer.
_from indexes balances and allowed in transferFrom.
_to is the destination index of the balances addition in transferFrom.
_value feeds the guard conditions and every arithmetic update in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is checked and decremented in transferFrom.
The balances mapping is read and updated inside transferFrom.
The allowed mapping is checked and decremented inside transferFrom.
_owner is the lookup key used by balanceOf.
balanceOf reads balances[_owner] and returns it.
_spender is the inner key written into the allowed mapping by approve.
_value is the allowance amount stored by approve.
msg.sender is the owner key under which approve stores the allowance.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
_owner is the outer key read by allowance.
_spender is the inner key read by allowance.
allowance returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
_spender is the untrusted target whose allowance is set and which receives the external call.
_value is stored as allowance and forwarded as calldata to the untrusted spender.
_extraData is forwarded verbatim into the external call payload.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key and is passed as the _from argument of receiveApproval.
The caller controlled _spender is the target of the low-level call, letting an attacker supplied contract execute arbitrary code.
_value is forwarded into the external calldata, affecting the callee executed during the call.
The arbitrary _extraData bytes are appended to the external call calldata, enabling attacker controlled execution.
msg.sender is passed into the external call, so a re-entered call is attributed to the original caller and its fresh state.
The allowance state is updated before the external call, a classic checks-effects-interactions ordering that enables reentrancy.
The constructor credits the entire initial supply to msg.sender.
The constructor writes balances[msg.sender] with the initial supply.
The constructor assigns totalSupply.
The constructor sets the token name.
The constructor sets the decimals value.
The constructor sets the token symbol.

normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter only exists to key the balances update inside StandardToken.transfer and has no standalone semantic weight.
_value is the amount consumed by the transfer guard and unchecked balance arithmetic, fully subsumed by the function.
_from is only used as the balances/allowed index inside transferFrom.
_to is only the destination index of the balances addition inside transferFrom.
_value is consumed by the guard conditions and arithmetic of transferFrom only.
_owner is a pure lookup key for the balanceOf getter.
_spender is only the allowance key written by approve.
_value is only the allowance amount written by approve.
_owner is a lookup key used solely inside the allowance getter.
_spender is a lookup key used solely inside the allowance getter.
_spender is the untrusted allowance key and the target of the external call owned by approveAndCall.
_value is stored as allowance and forwarded as calldata only within approveAndCall.
_extraData is opaque bytes passed straight through to the external call made by approveAndCall.
